items.title: Wikipedia Search Application
items.description: A custom Wikipedia search experience where users can search topics and view curated, well-formatted results pulled from the public API.
highlights: Live search with debounced API calls
Curated result cards with external links

items.title: Todos Application
items.description: A clean, reactive Todo manager — create tasks, mark them complete, and remove finished work. Persists state and works seamlessly on mobile.
highlights: Local persistence so nothing is lost

items.title: Understanding TypeScript
items.description: Hands-on follow-along of Maximilian Schwarzmüller's Udemy course — deep-diving into TypeScript's type system, generics, decorators, and tooling.

items.title: ML Essentials
items.description: Classic machine-learning workouts — KNN digit recognition and logistic regression for the Iris flower classification & California house-price prediction, all built with scikit-learn.
highlights: KNN classifier on the digits dataset
Logistic regression on Iris flower classification

items.title: LangChain · NLP & GenAI
items.description: Exploration of LangChain for building GenAI workflows — covering NLP fundamentals, retrieval pipelines, and Neo4j as a graph database for context-aware reasoning.
highlights: Neo4j graph database integration for context
